summary: Accounting Dashboard Enhancements testing complete. All features working correctly - 3 tabs visible (Journal Entries, Payroll Summary, Chart of Accounts), KPI cards showing correct data, balance indicators working, Payroll Only filter functional.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/accounting/payroll-summary correctly returns entries array and kpis object
KPIs include all required fields: total_entries, total_debits, total_credits, all_balanced, posted_count, draft_count, last_entry_date
Payroll entries are enriched with is_balanced, period_status, period_description, employee_count
Balance column in Journal Entries table shows green checkmark for balanced entries
Payroll Only filter correctly filters entries by entry_type='payroll'
All data-testid attributes present: tab-journal-entries, tab-payroll-summary, tab-chart-of-accounts, filter-only-payroll, payroll-summary-tab
seed_data_creation: Used existing payroll JE from previous test iteration
